newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-WIDZEW LODZ V BORUSSIA DORTMUND TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WIDZEW LODZ V BORUSSIA DORTMUND TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup Champions' League group B match between Widzew Lodz of Poland and Borussia Dortmund of Germany:

Widzew Lodz - 1-Maciej Szczesny, 2-Miroslaw Szymkowiak, 3-Tomasz Lapinski, 5-Pawel Wojtala, 6-Marek Citko, 7-Radoslaw Michalski, 8-Jacek Dembinski, 10-Ryszard Czerwiec, 12-Slawomir Majak, 15-Daniel Bogusz, 17-Andrzej Michalczuk.

Borussia Dortmund - 1-Stefan Klos, 2-Knut Reinhardt, 6-Matthias Sammer, 7-Stefan Reuter, 10-Andreas Moeller, 11-Heiko Herrlich, 14-Paul Lambert, 15-Juergen Kohler, 17-Jorg Heinrich, 18-Lars Ricken, 23-Rene Tretschok
